instruction: Create a LUKS2 container on /dev/sdb, open it, and create a VDO volume on top
output: sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 /dev/sdb && sudo cryptsetup open /dev/sdb crypt_vdo && sudo vdo create --name=vdo_crypt --device=/dev/mapper/crypt_vdo --vdoLogicalSize=500G

instruction: Create a ZFS pool on top of a LUKS2-encrypted device
output: sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 /dev/sdb && sudo cryptsetup open /dev/sdb crypt_zfs && sudo zpool create tank_crypt /dev/mapper/crypt_zfs

instruction: Convert a LUKS2 encrypted device to use LVM and format with XFS
output: sudo cryptsetup open /dev/sdb crypt_lvm && sudo pvcreate /dev/mapper/crypt_lvm && sudo vgcreate vg_data /dev/mapper/crypt_lvm && sudo lvcreate -n lv_data -l 100%FREE vg_data && sudo mkfs.xfs /dev/vg_data/lv_data

instruction: Extend a LUKS2+LVM logical volume and resize the filesystem online
output: sudo lvextend -L +10G /dev/vg_encrypted/lv_secure && sudo resize2fs /dev/vg_encrypted/lv_secure

instruction: Replace a failed disk in a ZFS mirror pool
output: sudo zpool offline tank /dev/sdb && sudo zpool replace tank /dev/sdb /dev/sdf && sudo zpool online tank /dev/sdf

instruction: Create a RAID10 mdadm array and format it with Bcachefs
output: sudo mdadm --create /dev/md10 --level=10 --raid-devices=4 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc /dev/sdd /dev/sde && sudo bcachefs format /dev/md10 && sudo mount -t bcachefs /dev/md10 /mnt/raid10

instruction: Set up a Stratis pool with an encrypted LUKS2 backing device
output: sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 /dev/sdb && sudo cryptsetup open /dev/sdb crypt_stratis && sudo stratis pool create str_crypt /dev/mapper/crypt_stratis

instruction: Display the ZFS ARC statistics in real time
output: sudo arcstat 1

instruction: Display a compressed ZFS send stream to save bandwidth
output: sudo zfs send -c tank/data@snap1 | ssh remote sudo zfs recv -s tank/backup

instruction: Create a ZFS deduplicated dataset
output: sudo zfs set dedup=on tank/data

instruction: Create a thin LVM pool and a thin volume with 200G virtual size
output: sudo lvcreate -L 50G -T vg_data/thin_pool && sudo lvcreate -V 200G -T vg_data/thin_pool -n lv_thin

instruction: Enable the LVM writecache on a logical volume using an SSD
output: sudo lvcreate -L 10G -n lv_cache vg_data /dev/nvme0n1 && sudo lvconvert --type writecache --cachepool vg_data/lv_cache vg_data/lv_slow

instruction: Split a ZFS mirror pool into two independent pools
output: sudo zpool split tank tank_new

instruction: Convert a ZFS pool encryption from passphrase to keyfile
output: sudo zfs change-key -o keyformat=raw -o keylocation=file:///root/key tank/data

instruction: Create a RAID6 array with mdadm and format with ZFS
output: sudo mdadm --create /dev/md6 --level=6 --raid-devices=4 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc /dev/sdd /dev/sde && sudo zpool create tank_md6 /dev/md6

instruction: Create a VDO volume with a 4K block size on a 512e drive
output: sudo vdo create --name=vdo_4k --device=/dev/sdf --vdoLogicalSize=2T --blockSize=4096

instruction: Set up LVM caching with a cache pool and cache volume
output: sudo lvcreate -L 20G -n lv_fast vg_data /dev/nvme0n1 && sudo lvcreate -L 200G -n lv_slow vg_data /dev/sdb && sudo lvconvert --type cache-pool --poolmetadata vg_data/lv_fast vg_data/lv_fast && sudo lvconvert --type cache --cachepool vg_data/lv_fast vg_data/lv_slow

instruction: Grow an XFS filesystem on an LVM logical volume after extending it
output: sudo lvextend -L +50G /dev/vg_data/lv_home && sudo xfs_growfs /home

instruction: Use pvs with seg reporting to show allocation per physical volume
output: sudo pvs --segments

instruction: Display the LVM configuration from lvm.conf for global_filter
output: sudo lvmconfig global_filter

instruction: Create a ZFS clone and mount it at a temporary location
output: sudo zfs clone tank/data@snap1 tank/clone_test && sudo zfs set mountpoint=/mnt/clone_test tank/clone_test && sudo mount -t zfs tank/clone_test /mnt/clone_test

instruction: Create a sparse ZFS volume (zvol) of 50G
output: sudo zfs create -V 50G -s tank/zvol_sparse

instruction: Send an incremental ZFS snapshot to a remote host
output: sudo zfs send -i tank/data@snap1 tank/data@snap2 | ssh backup sudo zfs recv tank/backup

instruction: Display the LVM volume group UUID
output: sudo vgs -o vg_uuid vg_data

instruction: Configure LVM to ignore a specific device via lvmdevices
output: sudo lvmdevices --deldev /dev/sdb
